name: car_coral
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite, ONE isolated object on genuinely TRANSPARENT background with real alpha (not white, not checkerboard). Reference image is the approved MATERIAL AND CONSTRUCTION style, not a layout to reproduce. Physical hand-cut corrugated cardboard collage, colored fibrous paper layers, visible corrugation only at edges, a few natural glue/scissor imperfections, soft daylight upper left. Straight-on orthographic paper piece, shallow 2mm thickness, all sharp and in focus, no cast shadow extending outside object. Keep chunky simple geometry readable at 50 pixels. No text, no watermarks, no extra props, no scenery, no glossy CGI, no black outlines, no vector illustration. Output a square canvas. Recreate only the reference coral bus as an individual asset. One squat rectangular coral-red cardboard bus facing RIGHT, two pale dusty-blue rectangular windows, exactly two black button wheels, small mustard paper headlamp on right. Whole silhouette fits within x=6..94%, y=22..77% of square; rest transparent. Match reference bus exactly in craft style and proportions.
